negative_findings.description: nabu.ua (Незалежна/Національна асоціація банків України) returned HTTP 429 on both the homepage and the sitemap page within this run.

Indexed pages (karta-sayta.html, struktura-nabu.html, zagalna-informatsiya.html, ru.html) show the site is live and multilingual; this is a rate-limit/bot defence, NOT evidence the site is dead.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names 'UCAB' as a banking/payments association.
negative_findings.result_summary: No banking or payments association matching 'UCAB' was found in uk or en searching. The established Ukrainian body using that acronym (ucab.ua) is the Ukrainian Agribusiness Club — an agriculture association, out of scope. The intended target is most likely УКБС (Український кредитно-банківський союз) or УАФІК.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted crawl budget on an out-of-scope agriculture domain and redirects it to УКБС/УАФІК.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Ukrainian for an official register of self-regulatory organisations (СРО) for financial-services / payment-market participants.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found the legal basis only (Art. 20 of the law on financial services defining СРО, and the historical Нацкомфінпослуг registration mandate). No live, published SRO register for the banking/payments segment was located; the NSSMC (НКЦПФР) SRO regime applies to capital markets, not payments.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that in UA banking/payments there is no formal SRO layer to enumerate — membership associations are voluntary, so no single roster is exhaustive and multiple associations must be unioned.

negative_findings.description: Searched in English for a European Banking Federation page listing Ukrainian associate members.
negative_findings.result_summary: EBF is confirmed to unite 33 national banking associations, but no page confirming a Ukrainian association's associate membership was found in results. Recorded as unconfirmed rather than negative.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An EBF/WSBI associate-member listing would be an independent third-party validation of which UA association is the recognised national body.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed a baseline snapshot now and query the Wayback Machine for historical captures of the ЄМА, АУБ and НАБУ member pages to build a back-series.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Attempt direct download of the latest editions from the association sites; if gated, log as a partial-access source and rely on trade-media summaries plus the mirrored PDFs.

brief: Ukraine has no compulsory SRO layer in banking or payments, so the actor population must be assembled by unioning several voluntary association rosters: three banking associations (НАБУ, АУБ, УКБС), the payments association ЄМА, the fintech association УАФІК, and non-bank bodies ВАФК/ВАКС/АФІ. The single richest page found is ЄМА's member directory, which enumerates card schemes, ~40 banks, PSPs, marketplaces and a credit bureau as linked entries and snowballs straight into corporate press/IR pages; АУБ adds a members list plus its own banking-statistics and Power BI analytics layer, and УАФІК's annual 'Каталог фінтех-компаній України' doubles as both a company roster and market-sizing study. Access is the main constraint rather than availability: nabu.ua rate-limited (429), fintechua.org is client-side rendered, and ukbs.org.ua failed DNS once — all treated as unverified, not dead, and all needing a rate-limited headless-browser pass. Registry cards (EDRPOU captured for all seven associations) and the NBU payment-systems participant register give an independent cross-check on any roster that turns out to be gated or stale.
